title: Fourier coefficient of a quadratic Boolean function
statement: Let $n$ be an even nonnegative integer and let $S$ be any subset of the $n$ coordinates. The absolute value of the Fourier coefficient indexed by $S$ of the real-valued complete quadratic Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube is $2^{-n/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
